title: Web3 Custodial Wallet — EventStack
jpTitle: Web3カストディアルウォレット
summary: A white-label custodial Web3 wallet for event ticketing that hides blockchain complexity behind three role-based interfaces — an end-user mobile wallet, an admin dashboard and a manager dashboard — for NFT tickets with blockchain-verified access. Users never touch seed phrases or gas fees. Won a 2023 Merit Gold Award in Metaverse and AI.

angles.product: The decisive design choice wasn't a wallet screen — it was refusing one universal dashboard and building three separate interfaces (end user, admin, manager) so each audience only saw the blockchain concepts relevant to their job, if any.

mine: Designed a white-label custodial wallet that abstracts away blockchain complexity
Chose role-based interfaces over one universal dashboard — separate End User, Admin and Manager experiences
Designed the End User mobile wallet, showing NFT tickets as simple event passes
Designed the Admin dashboard for managing events, minting tokens and authorizing staff
Designed the Manager dashboard for tracking financials and creating NFT ticket tiers
Mapped the stakeholder map, multi-user customer journey and service blueprint
team: Product Owner, UX Researcher, Software Engineers and Blockchain Engineers — credited on the page by role title, without individual task breakdown

metrics.label: role-based interfaces: End User, Admin, Manager
crypto knowledge required from end users

narrative.problem: Event management platforms lacked the security and customization Web3 could provide, but Web3 UX was too complex for non-crypto users — the gap between what the technology enabled and what event organizers could actually deploy was enormous.
built: Custodial model requiring no seed phrases or gas fees from users
